user.title: Sync two to-do lists
user.description: Items are matched by name. List A may be a list that cannot keep checked-off items (such as the Alexa shopping list): an item disappearing there is checked off in list B, and checking it off in list B removes it from list A.

abort.already_configured: These two lists are already synced

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Sync all configured list pairs immediately.

force.name: Force
force.description: Also sync when more than half of the items would be removed or checked off at once (normally treated as an outage of one list).
